title: Three Days and One Short Tape
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：incident　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 incident 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the guard ① recorded the incident that no witness in the platform would have described, and he said the recording was the whole of the day. The ② incident, meaning the event itself and not the tape, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; a incident, he said, is the only thing in a platform that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ incident in that platform had the same short tape beside it, and the ④ incident at the far exit, meaning the report they kept for the children to read and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A incident, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the guard said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the incident was the whole of the matter, meaning the lesson and not the event. The ⑥ incident, meaning the lesson and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; incident, he said, is either something you record or the only word that means both a event and a lesson. He said the lesson is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ incident had become a line in a summary, and the summary had become an argument about the short tape. The ⑧ incident of the whole thing, the guard wrote in February, was one platform and three days of describing; incident, he said, is either the report at the far exit or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ incident I remember is the event described in the summary, which closed in 1996 and is still described as the quietest in the platform. A ⑩ incident, my mother said in 1998, is the only event that improves by being described; every incident, she said, is a lesson that has agreed to look like a event. She said the lesson was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 事件；事故（指站台里每一起旁边的那一起）
B. n. 事件；事故（指那起事情本身，与警戒带相对）
C. 固定搭配：record the incident 记录这起事件
D. n. 事件；事故（指留给孩子们读的那一则那一起）
E. n. 安全之事（抽象总称，指一处站台的事件之事）
F. n. 事件；事故（指纪要里写到、被记下的的那一起）
G. n. 教训、警示（指一件事里人人都防却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 警示（抽象总称，指人人都防却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: recorded the incident that no witness in the platform would have described
The incident, meaning the event itself and not the tape
the incident at the far exit
the incident was the whole of the matter
the incident had become a line in a summary
The incident of the whole thing
A incident, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: record the incident 意为“记录这起事件”，1989 年那位保安把站台里没有一位目击者肯描述的一起事件做了一遍。
incident 意为“事件；事故”，指那起事情本身而不是警戒带，它经过了三个天而在簿子上没有被描述。
incident 意为“事件；事故”，指站台里每一起旁边的那一起，每一起旁边都有同一卷窄窄的警戒带。
incident 意为“事件；事故”，指最远那个出口留给孩子们读的那一则那一起，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
incident 意为“教训、警示”，指一件事里人人都防却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次教训就是那件事的全部。
incident 意为“警示”，指人人都防却无人提起的那样东西而不是那起事情，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
incident 意为“事件；事故”，指纪要里写到、被记下的的那一起，到 1994 年这一起成了纪要里的一行。
incident 意为“安全之事”，保安二月写道，整件事的事件之事是一处站台和三个天的描述。
incident 意为“事件；事故”，我记得的是纪要里描述过的那一起，1996 年查明了，至今仍被说成站台里最安静的一起。
incident 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，事件是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的事情。

那起事件，指的是那起事情本身而不是警戒带，经过了三个天而在簿子上没有被描述。（incident）
那处站台里每一起事件旁边都有同一卷窄窄的警戒带。（incident）
